ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Fighters Guild ranks
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Practice with any colonist. Both stop what they are doing and both gain skill XP. Once per day.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Work through the guild's craft with another member. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Look over a junior member's gear. Good upkeep earns praise and poor upkeep earns a sharp word.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Set a junior member to tedious labor for a failure, souring their mood. Once per day per member.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Call on {0} to fight harder for a short while. Once every few days.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to fall in behind you, up to four deep. They hold formation until released.
ESCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Release {0} from formation so they can return to their duties.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: associate
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: A new hand on the Guild's books, given the dull and dangerous contracts nobody else wants.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: journeyman
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: A proven contract fighter trusted to work without a minder.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: defender
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Holds a chapter's walls and teaches its new hands to hold a line.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: guardian
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: Leads contracts of real weight and answers for those who fight under them.

ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.label: champion
ESCP.Ranks.RankTierDef.description: One of the Guild's finest blades, named across Tamriel's chapter houses.
